# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| assessment-report | `bc-assessment-report.md` next to the case: scorecard with criterion, verdict (pass, partial, gap), evidence and note | `bc-capital-request`, OD lead | Every rubric criterion scored with evidence (file and section); A criterion that cannot be scored is marked gap with the missing input named |
| conflict-register | Section of the report: every input, what the case drew from it, each conflict and how it was resolved | `bc-build` | Every input file listed; Every conflict between sources has a resolution and a reason |
| maturity-gate-verdict | Verdict line in the report: Ready to sign, Sign the floor and validate the upside, or Not ready | `bc-capital-request`, approvers | One verdict stated; Not ready names the missing input and its owner; The assessor is not the case builder |
| ranked-open-questions | Section of the report, normalized influence 0-100, grouped into blocks one conversation can close | `bc-build` | Questions ranked and grouped |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| assessment-report | manual | OD lead |
| conflict-register | manual | OD lead |
| maturity-gate-verdict | manual | approvers |
| ranked-open-questions | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `bc-build`, `bc-cost`
- **Next:** a signable case goes to bc-capital-request (step 25); an unsigned case goes back to bc-build with the findings.: `bc-capital-request`, `bc-build`
- **Stops here when:** the assessor is the builder of the case (name a different assessor), or any C criterion is a gap (blocks signing)
- **Stops here when:** Do not fix the case while assessing it
